question: What was Oracle's total remaining performance obligations at the end of Q1 FY2027, and what percentage does Oracle expect to recognize as revenue over the next 12 months?

output.answer:
**Question:** What was Oracle's total remaining performance obligations at the end of Q1 FY2027, and what percentage does Oracle expect to recognize as revenue over the next 12 months?
*As of 2026-10-01*

| | Total remaining performance obligations (USD billions) | Share of RPO expected to be recognized as revenue over the next 12 months (%) |
|---|---|---|
| Oracle — Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended August 31, 2026) | $664 billion [1][2] | approximately 13% [1] |

- Oracle's total remaining performance obligations (RPO) were $664 billion as of August 31, 2026, the end of Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended August 31, 2026), as reported in the company's 10-Q. [1][2]
- Oracle expects to recognize approximately 13% of its RPO as revenues over the next twelve months, per the remaining performance obligations note in the Q1 FY2027 10-Q. [1]
- Oracle's Q1 FY2027 earnings release (8-K EX-99.1, filed September 10, 2026) reported RPO up $209 billion year-over-year to $664 billion. [3]
- The 10-Q also reported RPO of $664 billion as of August 31, 2026 versus $455 billion as of August 31, 2025, with the increase primarily attributable to certain significant cloud contracts entered into during the period. [1]

**Sources**
[1] ORACLE CORP 10-Q for Q1 FY2027 (filed 2026-09-11) (www.sec.gov, 2026-09-11, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526389274/orcl-20260831.htm
[2] ORACLE CORP XBRL data tagged in 10-Q filed 2026-09-11 (www.sec.gov, 2026-09-11, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526389274/
[3] ORACLE CORP earnings release for Q1 FY2027, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2026-09-10) (www.sec.gov, 2026-09-10, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000119312526387905/orcl-ex99_1.htm
